title: 820 comment sentences over 40 words in 597 units across 37 test files (C5)
claim: At 92d38ecb, 597 of the 3664 claim-bearing D5 units in the seat's cells hold at least one sentence over 40 words (820 such sentences, median 49 words, max 181), against criterion C5's limit of 40.
mechanism: Comment blocks in the test suite carry the reasoning and history of each check in long compound sentences joined by dashes, colons and parenthetical asides. The splitter is conservative: blank lines, rule lines, list items, indented lines, a trailing ':' and ';' all close a sentence.

evidence.contention_note: other finder seats on the box; count is contention-immune
